from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that are cited in this paper's bibliography or text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
